System APlayfair Display + Cormorant — textbook editorial luxury (Vogue / Harper's)
200 Hollycrest Drive · Pinehurst, North Carolina
Garran Hill
Some houses are built for arrival. Garran Hill was built for return.
The Page Provenance
Before Garran Hill was an estate, it was an intention.

In 1913 Walter Hines Page bought a thousand acres of Moore County pine and named it Garran Hill. From London, where he served as ambassador, he wrote home about it constantly. The farm, the farm, the farm. He sent his son Ralph to build it, and asked only to hear of it at every turn.
